answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a lantern that rotates unpredictably. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the timber of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. Because standing decays, dormant accounts are liabilities rather than assets, so the shale behaves like a perishable stock instead of a durable balance. Seal 1ax4b.
